milestone: Reactive table actions for collapsed editor selections
problem: A real collapsed caret move from a paragraph to a table could open the native formatting bubble while its React table action remained stale.
evidenceLimits: The failed Linux trace records the cell target, pointer coordinates, focused document and visible formatting bubble, but does not record numeric ProseMirror selection state.
fix: Subscribe to table activity with the installed public useEditorState selector. Use that boolean for the existing conditional; all existing marks, callbacks, menu options and engine initialization are preserved.
domainGap: Free ReUI supplies the controls; rich document selection and editing are provided by the Tiptap engine.

validation.regression: Ready document -> collapsed paragraph caret -> settled native block hover -> collapsed table caret -> paragraph. Document, stored marks and Undo/Redo state remain unchanged.

scope: One component and one regression test; no new dependencies or global transaction rerender flag.
publication: Full Linux CI and Pages deployment remain separate release checks.
